substantive_checks.declared_height: PASS: fixed sparsity and degree, polynomial coefficient height, and O(n/log n) gap budget give conservative residual height O(n)
substantive_checks.homogeneous_reduction: PASS: equal monomial degree supplies one common q_(n+1) unit modulo every Q dividing q_n, so scalar and primitive residual sums have the same Q-gcd
substantive_checks.cancellation_quotient: PASS: after dividing by the exact common term gcd B, primewise truncation proves X_Sigma divides R/B
substantive_checks.global_height: PASS: the entire sum-only quotient has log at most log|R/B|<=O(n)=o(n log n) on the balanced beta scale
substantive_checks.forced_target: PASS: if Q divides the residual sum, the leftover Q/gcd(Q,B) divides R/B and therefore has only O(n) logarithmic height
substantive_checks.valuation_split: PASS: a unique least p-adic term gives no sum-only factor; all additional depth lies in tied-minimum cancellation and is covered by R/B
substantive_checks.identity_dichotomy: PASS: a nonzero O(n)-height residual cannot be divisible by the full q_n for all large n, while an identically zero residual supplies no nonzero height certificate
substantive_checks.product_overlap: PASS: the baseline gcd(Q,B) is the previously open Item 282 product-return channel up to O(log n) coefficient content, not new additive information
substantive_checks.capacity_booking: PASS: the declared homogeneous sum-only class has zero global Route-1 rate, but the product baseline and nonhomogeneous or unbounded classes remain open; no retained ceiling is reduced

strict_scope.proved: Bounded-sparsity, bounded-degree prime-independent homogeneous sums have only an O(n) sum-only cancellation quotient after exact product-baseline removal.
strict_scope.not_proved: The Item 282 high-efficiency product channel, nonhomogeneous sums, unbounded sparsity or degree, and arbitrary growing block determinants remain open.
strict_scope.finite_only: Replay examples certify the algebraic identities and valuation split but make no density or exceptional-prime inference.
